constraints.text: Debt is the binding constraint. Hidden debt surfaced in 2024-25 and ran to billions of dollars (TimesLive, July 2025). The IMF had outstanding purchases and loans of SDR 829.65 million on 31 March 2026 (IMF). The new programme is agreed at staff level but, in the sources found, not yet approved, and the Prime Minister says arrears must be cleared before the finances can stabilise.

constraints.text: The Sahel border is not Senegal's to secure alone. JNIM's fuel blockade of Mali, from September 2025, targeted tankers on the Senegal-Mali route, and trucks were burned on it. Senegal can guard its own trucks but cannot end the blockade (our reading).

paradoxes.text: Ending all foreign military presence was meant to show sovereignty (announced December 2024, completed July 2025), but the Dakar-Bamako road that Senegal still depends on is where trucks were burned in 2025. The exit from France's security role did not end Senegal's exposure to the Sahel war.

grand_strategy.reading: Senegal's grand strategy is to turn a debt crisis and a new oil and gas economy into sovereignty: it ended all foreign military presence, keeps the Dakar corridor to Mali open, and is rebuilding its IMF deal while reprofiling rather than formally restructuring. The binding constraint is the debt that the hidden-debt revelation exposed, which turns each lever (IMF approval, arrears, the new oil and gas revenue) into a condition rather than a choice. Not verified in this pass: the 2026 Faye-Sonko rift, the US aid cut and MCC, China's 2024 upgrade, the EU fisheries agreement, Russia, Turkey and the Gulf, the 2025 Casamance peace and the Thiaroye memory.

stances.note: Faye announced in December 2024 the end of all foreign military presence from 2025 (RFI), and the Camp Geille base and Dakar airfield were handed over on 17 July 2025 (AFP via Khaleej Times). Trend cooling from the end of the bases. Partner is our reading: transactional, with no alignment; no source uses the word (C). Bond grievance is our reading: the colonial past is the wound behind the exit, but no source in this pass names the Thiaroye memory or a French apology (gap). The 2025 reset and French aid and trade figures are not verified. The FRA card has no stance toward SEN, so France's side is a provisional reciprocal.

stances.note: Senegal sent troops in January 2017 to back Adama Barrow (BBC). Partner is our reading: cooperation without an alignment treaty. Bond kin is our reading (C): shared faith and language, and the 1981-89 Senegambia confederation, which Senegal left abruptly (Wikipedia index, tier 4, not cited here). Trend stable is a default, not a finding. Partner is our reading: transactional joint development with no alignment. Trend warming from the joint production and the 2026 cargo plan. Bond grievance is our reading: Wikipedia's index cites late-1980s clashes between farmers and herders that brought the two near war (no URL in the wikitext, tier 4, not cited here).
